# GridMomentum

A floating mob that steps off a moving ship keeps the ship's momentum. Upstream movement applies space friction and
push-off acceleration to the mob's map velocity, so leaving a ship's tiles braked the mob toward a standstill and the
ship ran on without it. Off a grid, `SharedMoverController` now does both relative to the nearest moving grid within
4 m of the mob (`WfGridFrame`), including the spin of a turning ship. On a grid nothing changes; far from any grid the
old map-relative drift applies.
